<p>It’s “quoted” text with a dash — and a café.</p>

<h2>Code by language</h2>
<p><strong>src/Duck.java</strong></p>
<pre>public class Duck {

    void quack() {
        System.out.println("Quack");
    }
}
</pre>
<p><strong>duck.py</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-python">def quack():

    print("Quack ✓")
</code></pre>
<p><strong>duck.js:</strong></p>
<pre>export const quack = () =&gt; "Quack";


export default quack;</pre>
<pre class="highlight language-typescript">export const quack = (): string =&gt; "Quack";</pre>
<p><strong>notes.txt</strong></p>
<pre>plain text, no language
</pre>
<pre class="highlight">unlabelled block</pre>
<p>Closing paragraph with <em>emphasis</em> and a <a href="https://example.com/post">link</a>.</p>
